dedupe_keys.name: engineering compendium of embankment dams in permafrost environments

description: This compendium compiles the engineering approaches and physical characteristics of more than 375 embankment dams built or designed in permafrost regions, from public information gathered before June 2024. Site conditions are organised with structural and permafrost engineering parameters under thermal regimes, thaw mitigation, hydraulic barriers, stability and deformation analysis, and instrumentation, so that designers can compare past and current practice for frozen-core and other embankment dams. It was built at Université Laval with funding from the Fonds de recherche du Québec and released on Borealis in March 2026 as an Excel workbook, an SQLite database, dam coordinates, references and a Windows display application, under CC BY-ND 4.0 (no derivatives). Caveats: coverage is limited to publicly documented dams in cold regions, construction processes and post-construction performance are excluded, and the licence forbids redistributing modified versions. Simulation uses: design parameters for climate adaptation and resilience assessment of dams on thawing permafrost. Related record: the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams).
name: Engineering compendium of embankment dams in permafrost environments
notes: The count of more than 375 dams comes from the harvested DataCite description; continents are inferred from where permafrost dams exist (Canada, Alaska, Russia, China, Nordic countries).
